description: Published out-of-sample accuracy of the best human and AI forecasters. Red entries show the available historical reconstruction and remain qualified.
audit_note: UNRESOLVED DATA / METHOD: red values use the older AI workbook, best AI per quarter versus the human median, and realized targets through 2024Q4. This historical reconstruction differs from the best-human rule in the caption. Red entries are not proven corrections.

method_evidence.selection: minimum individual absolute error separately in each survey and quarter
method_evidence.test: two-sided exact paired sign-flip of absolute-error differences; all 2^N assignments
method_evidence.input_vintage: current driver-selected OOS workbook; source cleaning rules applied
method_evidence.display_rounding: MAEs recomputed from Decimal(str(source forecast)) and Decimal(str(actual)), then decimal half-even to two places; original float calculations retained separately
